levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Checklist includes a real-looking ID number, insurance number, or specific real name instead of a general category label.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Checklist uses general category labels but lists fewer than three relevant document categories.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Fewer than four questions are written, or most questions cover the same single topic.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
